Hi Avery,

We signed up via the self-serve flow last month (trial account ID: ATL-9823). We're actively integrating Redwood for conversational search and are seeing steady token consumption, but the trial credits are burning faster than expected. Our engineering team has a final integration sprint next week and we risk hitting zero mid-sprint.

Can you do a short runway/top-up — 10–14 days — so we can complete the integration and finish the evaluation? We don't need a long commitment, just enough credits to avoid interruption (rough estimate: ~1k credits).

If there's a self-serve promo or a quick applied credit you can do, that would be ideal. Happy to provide any account details or a screenshot of the billing page.

Thanks,

Hi Devon — thanks for the details and congrats on the quick progress.

Quick questions so I can expedite:
- Can you confirm the Redwood account email (is it nina@atlas.ai or devon@atlas.ai)?
- Is the 1k credits estimate tokens or USD-equivalent? (Either is fine; we just need an amount to approve.)

We can do one of two paths:
1) Apply a temporary account credit (my usual approach) for 1,000 credits that expires in 14 days, or
2) Issue a one-time promo code you can redeem in the billing UI (self-serve).

If you want the fastest path, I can ask Marissa to approve an immediate applied credit and I will confirm once it's posted. Please reply with the account email and whether you prefer applied credit or a promo code.

Cheers,
